prompt: We have a Cisco ACI fabric and need to design a DMZ architecture for our private cloud. The DMZ hosts public-facing web servers (OpenStack VMs) and API gateways. We're deploying a Palo Alto PA-5400 HA pair as the perimeter firewall and a pair of F5 BIG-IP i5800 for load balancing. Both need to be inserted into the ACI fabric using Service Graphs. Internal traffic between application tiers should be microsegmented with ACI contracts. We also need SSL decryption on the Palo Alto for inbound HTTPS inspection before traffic hits the F5. Design the full traffic path, ACI Service Graph chaining, Palo Alto zones and policies, F5 virtual server configuration, and the monitoring approach. We use Ansible for all automation.

assertions.name: service_graph_chain
assertions.description: Designs ACI Service Graph chaining: traffic flows through Palo Alto THEN F5 (or explains the ordering decision)

assertions.name: paloalto_ha_design
assertions.description: Addresses PA-5400 HA pair configuration (active/passive or active/active, session sync)

assertions.name: paloalto_zones
assertions.description: Defines specific Palo Alto security zones (Untrust, DMZ, Trust, etc.) and inter-zone policies

assertions.name: ssl_decryption
assertions.description: Designs SSL decryption on Palo Alto (forward proxy or inbound inspection, certificate handling, decryption policy)

assertions.name: f5_virtual_servers
assertions.description: Designs F5 virtual server configuration (VIP, pool, health monitors, SSL profiles)

assertions.name: f5_ha_design
assertions.description: Addresses F5 i5800 HA pair (active/standby, config sync, traffic groups)

assertions.name: aci_pbr
assertions.description: Uses ACI Policy-Based Redirect for transparent service insertion

assertions.name: microsegmentation_contracts
assertions.description: Designs ACI contracts for east-west microsegmentation between application tiers

assertions.name: traffic_flow_complete
assertions.description: Shows complete traffic path: Internet → ACI L3Out → Palo Alto → F5 → Web EPG → App EPG → DB EPG

assertions.name: ansible_automation
assertions.description: Covers Ansible automation for all three platforms (cisco.aci, paloaltonetworks.panos, f5networks.f5_modules)

assertions.name: monitoring_health_scores
assertions.description: Addresses monitoring across ACI (health scores, faults), Palo Alto (ACC, threat logs), and F5 (pool member health)

assertions.name: device_package_registration
assertions.description: Mentions ACI device package registration for Palo Alto and/or F5 on APIC
